description: How bitcoin and the meme coin boom exploded — then imploded, then fragmented into new micro-surges. Market-cap history (2006–2026) showing BTC/Ethereum dominance and the meteoric pump-and-crash cycles of Dogecoin, Shiba Inu and PEPE.
youtube_description:
The Meme Coin Meltdown — market-cap history (2006–2026) that tells the real story: Bitcoin and Ethereum rise to dominance while meme coins explode into the mainstream and then implode into tiny empires. This visualization tracks the major real-world pump-and-crash moments: the 2013 altcoin wake-up, the 2017 ICO frenzy, the 2021 meme coin mania (Dogecoin & Shiba Inu), the systemic 2022 crypto winter after institutional shocks and exchange failures, and the micro-surfacing of tokens like PEPE in 2023.

Data notes: market-cap points shown are year markers (billions USD) pulled from public on-chain aggregates and historical snapshots (CoinMarketCap / CoinGecko / exchange-reported metrics) and company/blockchain explorer records. Pre-launch years show 0 for assets that didn't exist yet. This dataset is built for high-contrast chart-race visuals — watch the spikes, watch the crashes.

If you loved this timeline, smash LIKE, SUBSCRIBE for more chart-race breakdowns, and drop a comment on which coin surprised you the most. Want a custom chart-race topic? Tell me in the comments!

Sources: CoinMarketCap historical snapshots, CoinGecko, major news coverage of 2021 meme pump, 2022 market collapse (FTX & Terra contagion), 2023 memecoin micro-surges.
